e2e.//: The inferred Playwright target owns a browser, app server and fixed-port Synapse stack. Its runtime result must never be restored from cache or overlap another Synapse owner.

lint.//: Declared, not inferred: @nx/eslint only infers a lint target for projects with .ts/.js sources, and every file here is .mts — so removing 'e2e' from globalIgnores would otherwise have changed nothing about what `pnpm lint` actually runs.

typecheck.//: The e2e tree has no spec/app split, so unlike every other project this one points at its own tsconfig.json rather than a tsconfig.spec.json; the target default's command is overridden here for that reason alone.

storybook-e2e.//: A separate browser lifecycle from the app E2E target: static Storybook needs no Synapse, and this target is intentionally uncached because its webServer builds component stories and theme files outside the e2e project input graph.

web-e2e.//: Production Web/PWA startup, routing and offline checks against the exact shared www artifact. No Synapse or Docker is required.

phase7-e2e.//: Shipped real-app semantic, responsive, contrast and geometry coverage. Serialized because it owns the fixed Synapse stack and deterministic accounts.

styling-e2e.//: A separate browser lifecycle from the Synapse-backed app journeys. It is intentionally uncached because its webServer builds application/theme files outside the e2e project input graph.

scrollbars-e2e.//: Focused Chromium, Firefox and WebKit scrollbar contract against the real app and disposable Synapse.

android-e2e.//: Owns an installed API 36 WebView, a fixed-port Synapse stack, and adb reverse state. Those external resources are intentionally serialized and never cacheable.
